fib: ______ is an act upon whose execution the resulting molecular appearance is indistinguishable from the one before that operation was executed.
symmetry operation
A symmetry operation is an act upon whose execution the resulting molecular appearance is indistinguishable from the one before that operation was executed.
______ is a rule for predicting the shape of a molecule and states that a molecule will adopt a structure that best provide the most stability of its HOMO.
Walsh rule
Walsh rule is a rule for predicting the shape of a molecule and states that a molecule will adopt a structure that best provide the most stability of its HOMO.
______ is a very serious parameter that govern the selection rule (i.e. allowed and forbidden transitions).
Dipole moment
Dipole moment is a very serious parameter that govern the selection rule (i.e. allowed and forbidden transitions).
______ is an intrinsic property of a substance that is the measure of heat energy required to raise a unit mass of a substance by one-unit degree.
Specific heat
Specific heat is an intrinsic property of a substance that is the measure of heat energy required to raise a unit mass of a substance by one-unit degree.
______ is a mathematical expression that can be used to know allowed or forbidden spectroscopic transition.
selection rule
The selection rule is a mathematical expression that can be used to know allowed or forbidden spectroscopic transition.
______ are those that belong to the electromagnetic spectrum.
Radiations relevant in spectroscopic study
Radiations relevant in spectroscopic study are those that belong to the electromagnetic spectrum.
______ is the study of the absorption or emission of electromagnetic radiation by molecules.
Molecular spectroscopy
Molecular spectroscopy is the study of the absorption or emission of electromagnetic radiation by molecules.
______ is the Schrodinger equation and its importance is based on the fact that solutions to quantum systems can be derived through the Schrodinger equation.
fundamental wave equation
